# netmaker_network (Resource)

Manages a Netmaker network.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Network name (Netmaker's netid). 1-32 characters. Changing this forces recreation.

### Optional

- `address_range` (String) IPv4 CIDR pool for this network, e.g. 10.10.0.0/16. At least one of address_range/address_range6 is required.
- `address_range6` (String) IPv6 CIDR pool for this network. At least one of address_range/address_range6 is required.
- `auto_join` (Boolean) Whether new enrollment keys default to auto-joining this network.
- `auto_remove` (Boolean) Whether inactive nodes are automatically removed from this network.
- `auto_remove_tags` (List of String) Tags whose nodes are eligible for auto-remove (or the literal "*" for all nodes in the network). Each tag must already exist as a netmaker_tag — auto-created if missing, same as default_enrollment_key.tags, since this can be set in the same apply that creates the network itself, before a netmaker_tag resource scoped to it could exist.
- `auto_remove_threshold` (Number) Minutes of inactivity before auto-remove applies.
- `default_enrollment_key` (Attributes) Netmaker auto-creates an unlimited enrollment key scoped to this network whenever the network is created (and deletes it when the network is deleted) — this manages that key's editable settings in place rather than requiring a separate netmaker_enrollment_key resource plus a manual import; see default_value/default_token for its value/token. Omit to leave its settings as Netmaker's defaults (no gateway, no tags). Additional independent keys for this network can still be declared as separate netmaker_enrollment_key resources. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--default_enrollment_key))
- `jit_enabled` (Boolean) Whether just-in-time access is enabled for this network. Only honored at network creation — Netmaker's network update API silently ignores changes to this after creation, so changing it here forces recreation instead of a no-op update.

### Read-Only

- `default_token` (String, Sensitive) Base64-encoded join token for the network's default enrollment key, to pass to `netclient join -t`.
- `default_value` (String) Server-assigned value of the network's default enrollment key.
- `id` (String) Server-assigned network ID.

<a id="nestedatt--default_enrollment_key"></a>
### Nested Schema for `default_enrollment_key`

Optional:

- `auto_assign_gateway` (Boolean) Whether devices enrolled with this key auto-select a gateway.
- `gateway_id` (String) ID of the relay/gateway node devices enrolled with this key are auto-relayed through, if any.
- `tags` (List of String) Tags to apply to devices enrolled with this key.
